Metadata.description: A digital workspace portal: reach the apps you have access to, and request the ones you don't.

SignIn.title: Welcome to {name}
SignIn.intro: One place for the apps we run. Sign in once, and everything you can use is a click away. Anything else, you can ask for.
SignIn.passkeyHint: No password: your phone or computer unlocks it, like it does for your banking app.
SignIn.firstTimeBody: Use the invite link an admin sent you to set up your sign-in.
SignIn.step1Body: With your phone or computer. No password to remember.
SignIn.step2Body: Each app says what it’s for. Click it and it opens.
SignIn.step3Body: Missing something? Ask, and an admin lets you in.

Home.greeting: {name, select, __none {Hi there.} other {Hi {name}.}} What would you like to do?

YourApps.heading: Your apps
YourApps.loadError: We couldn’t load your apps just now.
YourApps.loadErrorDetail: It’s usually brief. Your apps themselves still work.
YourApps.seeAllOrAsk: See all apps, or ask for more
YourApps.emptyTitle: You don’t have any apps yet.
YourApps.emptyAskBody: See what’s available, and ask for what you need. An admin lets you in.
YourApps.emptyAskAdmin: Ask an administrator to give you access.

Apps.title: Apps
Apps.intro: Everything you can open, and what else you can ask for.
Apps.tipBody: Each card says what the app is for. Click one and it opens. You won’t need another password.
Apps.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, or by what it’s for
Apps.found: {count, plural, one {# app found.} other {# apps found.}}
Apps.usableEmptyAsk: Nothing yet. Ask for something below, and it shows up here once an admin lets you in.
Apps.usableEmptyAdmin: You don’t have access to any apps yet. Ask an administrator.
Apps.askIntro: Ask, and an admin will let you in. It moves up to “What you can use” once they do.
Apps.noGroup: No group grants access to this app yet.
Apps.settlingDetail: It shows up under “What you can use” within a few minutes, or right away if you sign out and back in.
Apps.revokedDetail: You had this before, but the group no longer grants it. You can ask again.
Apps.deniedDetail: You can ask again if things have changed.

AskForm.reasonLabel: Why do you need it? {required, select, yes {(required)} other {(optional)}}
AskForm.reasonPlaceholder: The admin sees this when they decide.
AskForm.already_active: You’ve already asked for this role. Reload the page to see where it stands.
AskForm.already_granted: You already have this role. Reload the page to see it.
AskForm.not_allowed: That role can’t be requested for this app any more. Reload the page to see what’s available.
AskForm.message_too_long: Keep your reason to {max} characters or fewer.
AskForm.reason_required: Add a reason, so the admin knows why you need it.
AskForm.requests_disabled: Access requests aren’t being taken at the moment. Reload the page.
AskForm.rate_limited: You’ve sent a lot of requests in the last hour. Try again later.

AdminApps.title: App catalog
AdminApps.intro: Your apps come from PocketID, where you add, rename and describe them and choose who can use them. Here you choose which ones people see on the Apps page, and how they’re grouped.
AdminApps.summary: {apps, plural, one {# app} other {# apps}} · {shown} shown{fix, plural, =0 {} one { · # needs a fix} other { · # need a fix}}
AdminApps.emptyNone: PocketID has no OIDC clients yet. Add one there and it appears here.

AdminApp.title: Edit app
AdminApp.hiddenNote: Hidden: nobody sees it, and it can't be requested.
AdminApp.shownNote: Listed for everyone signed in, with a way to ask for it if they can't open it yet.
AdminApp.noLinkNote: On, but it has no launch link, so it isn't listed yet.
AdminApp.categoryHint: The heading it sits under on the Apps page. Leave it empty for “Other”.
AdminApp.noDescriptionTip: No description, so people only see the name. Write what it’s for, like “Watch films and series”, not what it is.
AdminApp.noLinkTip: No http(s) launch link, so it can’t be opened from the portal and isn’t listed, even when shown.

AdminRequests.title: Requests
AdminRequests.waiting: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody is waiting} one {1 person is waiting} other {# people are waiting}}
AdminRequests.intro: People asking for an app they can’t open yet. Approving adds them to the app’s group in PocketID; if that fails, the request stays here.
AdminRequests.switchedOff: New requests are switched off (FEATURE_ACCESS_REQUESTS). You can still decide these.
AdminRequests.caughtUpDetail: New requests show up here, and in the menu’s count.
AdminRequests.approvingAddsOpens: Approving adds them to {group}, which opens {apps}.
AdminRequests.cantApprove: Can’t be approved: the app is hidden, or this group was removed from it in PocketID.
AdminRequests.notGrantable: This group can’t be granted for this app any more: the app is hidden, or the group was removed from it in PocketID. Decline the request instead.

AdminAudit.title: History
AdminAudit.intro: Every request and decision, newest first, including grants PocketID refused or that failed.

SecretsBanner.label: Security warning
SecretsBanner.lead: PocketID exposes its SMTP/LDAP passwords to this portal’s API key.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: That URL doesn’t match anything in this workspace. It may have been an app link that changed, or a page you don’t have access to.

AuthError.title: Sign-in problem
AuthError.heading: Sign-in didn’t work
AuthError.Configuration: There's a problem with the portal's setup, so it couldn't sign you in. If you run this portal, its logs say what went wrong.
AuthError.AccessDenied: PocketID didn't let you sign in to this portal. Ask an admin if you think you should have access.
AuthError.Verification: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Start again from the sign-in page.
AuthError.fallback: Something went wrong while signing you in. Try again from the sign-in page.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.body: That action didn’t complete. Nothing was changed if it failed partway — you can try again, or head back and start over.
Error.globalBody: The portal couldn’t load. This usually means it can’t reach PocketID — trying again in a moment is the fastest fix.

Email.approvedBody: Your request for {group} was approved. It can take a few minutes to show up in the portal.
Email.deniedBody: Your request for {group} was denied. You can request it again with more detail.
